project_title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day — The Mutating DNA Paradox

beats.narration: You completely missed the most terrifying line in the new Spider-Man trailer.
beats.description: Trailer opening in dark room as Peter stares at his hands in shock

beats.narration: At the thirty-second mark, Peter Parker isn't fighting a villain.
beats.description: Peter Parker entering Bruce Banner's university laboratory

beats.narration: He's standing inside Bruce Banner's laboratory, asking a question nobody expected:
beats.description: Bruce Banner at desk analyzing holographic genetic helix data

beats.narration: "Dr. Banner, you found a way to suppress mutating DNA, right? Could you get rid of the bad aspects, but keep the good?"
beats.description: Banner turning around, looking over glasses with holographic DNA floating between them

beats.narration: Look closely at Banner’s holographic monitor. Flashing in the corner is a medical alert: "Retroviral Acceleration."
beats.description: Close-up punch into the holographic DNA helix with the medical alert nodes

beats.narration: And in the opening seconds, look at Peter’s forearm: black microscopic veins pulsing beneath his skin.
beats.description: Extreme close-up of Peter's forearm, black veins pulsing under skin

beats.narration: This isn't superhero fatigue. Marvel is adapting the legendary comic storyline where Peter's radioactive spider-bite begins to mutate his cellular biology, slowly destroying his body from the inside out.
beats.description: Peter staggering against the wall, pupil dilation with spider-sense pulses

beats.narration: Peter gave up his identity to save the world. Now, the very power that makes him Spider-Man might be the thing killing him.
beats.description: Spider-Man leaping off skyscraper into the freezing winter blizzard
